metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Back to practice squad
metadata.description: Austin reverted to the Saints' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Austin was elevated to the active roster for the second straight week, and he caught his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 24-17 win over the Ravens. He also logged four snaps with the special-teams unit, and he can be elevated one more time before he'd have to be officially signed to the active roster.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Elevated again for Week 2
metadata.description: The Saints elevated Austin from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Austin was elevated for the Saints' 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions in Week 1. The wide receiver played just six total snaps in the contest that ran past four quarters. Austin will likely play a similar role against the Ravens in Week 2, only making it onto the field as a depth option when necessary.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin Jr. Elevated for Week 2
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints wide receiver Kevin Austin Jr. has been elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's game at Baltimore, according to Erin Summers. The move comes with Chris Olave questionable because of a hamstring injury. Olave was added to the injury report Thursday and was limited both Thursday and Friday. Austin was elevated for Week 1 as well, but he played only five offensive snaps and wasn't targeted against Detroit. New Orleans also has Devaughn Vele, Barion Brown, and Bryce Lance on the active roster, so Austin isn't guaranteed much work even if Olave sits. For now, the elevation gives the Saints another receiver while Olave's status remains unsettled.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Reverts to NOLA's practice squad
metadata.description: Austin reverted to the Saints' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Austin played just six total snaps in Sunday's overtime loss to the Lions. The wide receiver played five offensive snaps, good for just five percent of the team's total offensive plays. Austin's extremely minimal usage in a long game signals the fourth-year player may not be required by the team in the future.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Elevated for Week 1
metadata.description: The Saints have elevated Austin from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.
metadata.analysis: Austin signed with the Saints' practice squad Sept. 2 after being waived by the team on cutdown day. The wide receiver will likely see minimal targets, as he is set to be the fifth option. If Austin does see the field, the majority of his snaps will likely occur on special teams.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Signs with practice squad
metadata.description: The Saints signed Austin to the practice squad Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The Saints waived Austin on Monday. The wide receiver made the team's initial 53-man roster before being cut to make additional room for players claimed off waivers. The wide receiver has played in eight games for the Saints each of the last two seasons and will likely see two to three contests in 2026 via practice squad elevation to the 53-man roster.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Parts ways with Saints
metadata.description: New Orleans waived Austin on Monday.
metadata.analysis: Austin suited up for exactly eight games of each of the past two seasons and compiled 24 catches for 291 yards and one touchdown over that span. He initially made the Saints' 53-man roster but was then cut Monday to make room for players awarded to the team on waivers. Austin is a prime candidate to serve on New Orleans' practice squad if he clears waivers.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin Jr. waived by Saints
metadata.description: The Saints waived WR Kevin Austin Jr.
metadata.analysis: Austin will figure to seek another opportunity heading into the season.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin Jr. sees nine targets in Week 18
metadata.description: Kevin Austin Jr. caught 4-of-9 targets for 37 yards in the Saints 19-17 loss against the Falcons.
metadata.analysis: Austin saw a team-high nine targets. The 2022 UDFA will remain off the fantasy radar heading into next season.

metadata.title: Kevin Austin - Draws nine targets in Week 18 loss
metadata.description: Austin caught four of nine targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Falcons.
metadata.analysis: With Chris Olave (blood clots) out for the regular-season finale, Austin filled the role of WR1 for Tyler Shough and drew a team-high nine targets. Austin ended up appearing in eight games for the Saints this season and finished with 13 catches for 140 yards and his first career touchdown. The 25-year-old is under contract through the 2026 campaign but likely won't be guaranteed a roster spot next summer.
